from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/58109/1_58109_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/58109_0_53a78e04/1_58109_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Sum sales for the current date and the previous 3 workdays, skipping weekends.
ws["I6"] = '=SUMIFS(B:B,A:A,">="&WORKDAY(I4,-3),A:A,"<="&I4)'

# Ensure Excel recalculates the formula when opened.
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True

wb.save(output_path)
